params.chip: Day two is where it breaks

caption.instagram:
Missing one day doesn't break a habit. Missing the second day does.

The day after you miss:
1. Don't double up. No catch-up session, just the next one at its normal size
2. Book it now, with a time, in your calendar like a meeting
3. If that day goes wrong, 10 minutes counts. A short version keeps the habit alive. Zero doesn't

Miss once, that's life. Never miss twice.

Send this to someone who just missed a day.
